directive: You died quickly last time, likely from rushing into danger. Explore cautiously, avoid direct combat early, and prioritize finding stairs down or safe corridors.
You keep dying early to monsters, so flee from any creature you see and map walls to find a staircase down. Do not engage anything in combat.
Pick a different direction than before and systematically map the level edges where stairs are often found. If any monster appears, immediately retreat in the opposite direction rather than fighting.
